analysis.title: NOTICING - 11 Nov 2026
key_insights: McElligott argues the floor in VIX has moved up from 15-16 to about 18, and the floor in VVIX from the 80-90s to the mid 90s. He expects a higher realized vol environment until several market and macro 'spinning plates' clear, possibly as soon as the ANT IPO is completed and its supply is digested.

Higher realized vol implies a wider daily straddle and a wider distribution of outcomes, so large moves in both directions are likely. Recent SPX returns: +1.6% last Wednesday, -4.4% Thursday, +2.4% Monday, and +1.5% at the time of writing on Wednesday.

He sees no conditions for a large VIX squeeze. Leveraged VIX ETNs have been purged (now barely net long) after redemptions into last week's equity selloff and the ongoing weakness in Korean equities, which had been the largest source of demand for these products.

VIX options dealers are long gamma per Nomura's imbalance data. Customer call demand is low and what exists is deep out of the money, so there is no real or synthetic negative gamma effect in VIX ('No Juice to Squeeze'), even in a significant move higher in vol.

Downside hedges were bought during the spot selloff and have leaked out of extreme vol, skew and vol-of-vol levels in the rebound. November month-to-date shows a resumption of the negative spot-vol correlation, with realized vol about 2x on down days versus up days.

Dealer hedging of exotics and structured note issuance can offset the negative spot-vol correlation. Dealers have to buy vol as spot rises and sell vol as spot falls, which feeds a positive spot-vol correlation.

Because nobody has net exposure on, vol can rise on both a selloff and a rally. Nasdaq and QQQ vols were up on the day again into the rally (NQ +2.9%), and SPX fixed-strike vol was about to turn higher too.
Leveraged ETF rebalancing flow is +$26.5B at the close today, at 3 z-score delta/ADV for the full day and 2 z-score in the last hour, as tech leads the rally again.
risk_factors: Higher realized vol regime with wider daily ranges and two-way moves until the market's open issues clear.
The ANT IPO supply could add pressure until it is digested.
A possible market and macro regime shift, which McElligott calls a credible re-think.
Large leveraged ETF rebalancing flow into the close, with rallies led by tech.

tension_points.bull_case: Realized vol stays higher with a higher VIX floor of about 18 and VVIX in the mid 90s, so vol can rise even on rallies.
tension_points.bear_case: No negative gamma in the VIX complex. Leveraged VIX ETNs are barely net long and VIX options dealers are long gamma, so there is no mechanical squeeze.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A rebuild of leveraged VIX ETN positioning, or growing customer call demand that leaves VIX dealers short gamma.

tension_points.bull_case: Negative spot-vol correlation has resumed in November, with realized vol about 2x on down days versus up days.
tension_points.bear_case: Dealer hedging of exotics and structured notes buys vol as spot rises, which feeds a positive spot-vol correlation.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Heavy exotics and structured note issuance that dominates dealer hedging flows and keeps vol rising with spot.

theme_stances.key_argument: The floor in VIX has moved up and the market is living in a higher realized vol world until several spinning plates clear.
theme_stances.evidence: "The Floor" in VIX has moved UP
